name: tween.js
role: Tiny numeric property interpolator with easing; you call update(time) yourself
summary: Minimal tweening engine: tween numeric properties of objects over a duration with easing, chaining and yoyo. Nothing runs on its own; the host calls update(time), so passing the harness time gives deterministic output. Typically used to feed Three.js or canvas values. Smallest of the tween tools, with no timeline, SVG or DOM helpers.
use_when: Interpolating object values inside a Three.js or canvas loop with explicit time
Over GSAP when you want a few kB and update(time) control
Chained numeric tweens without DOM involvement
avoid_when: DOM or SVG targets and labelled timelines: GSAP
Spring or velocity behaviour: Motion or React Spring
Complex sequences: Anime.js or GSAP timelines

assessment.rationale: Repo pushed 2026-10-06, so commits are active though last release 25.0.0 was 2024-07-26. Simple, deterministic via update(time); a neighbour to GSAP for raw numeric tweens.

evidence.result: 90 distinct 1280x720 alpha frames at 30 fps; all shuffled hashes equal sequential; frame 45 alpha min 0 max 1. Playwright 1.64.1, Chromium 156.0.8078.4, Node 22.19.0; screenshot route. Contact sheet inspected. A single update across a yoyo boundary gave a wrong position, so seek steps explicitly.
evidence.scope: Chained, yoyo and eased tweens in a Group rebuilt and stepped by explicit times, drawn to Canvas 2D as alpha PNG; macOS arm64 Chromium. No singleton, Three.js, DOM or export.
